summary: The full-SHA rule does not reach the new composite action. Rust is now installed through .github/actions/setup-rust, but supply_chain_errors scans only .github/workflows/*.yml (_is_workflow). Seeded on a throwaway worktree, `uses: actions/cache@v5` in setup-rust/action.yml passes the safety check (rc 0); the same ref in pr-guard.yml fails it (rc 1). The action has no external `uses:` today, so the invariant holds now, but every workflow's Rust install now goes through a file the rule never reads. Fix: scan .github/actions/**/action.y*ml with _scan_action_refs/_scan_downloads as well.
